items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We went on the road and did a couple of one nighters, we took Big Sid (inaudible) with us, you know. ... Big Sid Catlett made all the trips with us.

ctx.x: The doctor took some fluid out of it or something, you know. And it made him worse.
So then, he brought in Big Sid (Inaudible) -- he used to come up to the Savoy and sit in and play a couple of sets for him -- rest him
